scripts.build:remote-fs: bun --cwd=apps/core run build:remote-runner && bun --cwd=packages/remote-fs-runner run build
scripts.lint: oxlint --tsconfig tsconfig.json apps packages scripts/generate-provider-option-shapes.ts scripts/architecture scripts/oxlint-plugins examples __tests__ && bun run lint:architecture
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --tsconfig tsconfig.json --fix apps packages scripts/generate-provider-option-shapes.ts scripts/architecture scripts/oxlint-plugins examples __tests__
scripts.test:all: bun run test:root && bun run test:workspaces && bun run test:lint-rules && bun run test:architecture
scripts.test:ci: set -e; bun run test:root -- --only-failures; for dir in apps/* packages/*; do bun --cwd="$dir" run test -- --only-failures; done; bun test --only-failures ./scripts/oxlint-plugins/*.test.mts; node --experimental-strip-types scripts/oxlint-plugins/test-waits.rule-test.mts; bun run test:architecture -- --only-failures
scripts.typecheck: set -e; pids=''; for dir in apps/* packages/*; do if [ -f "$dir/tsconfig.json" ]; then bunx tsc -p "$dir/tsconfig.json" --noEmit & pids="$pids $!"; fi; done; for pid in $pids; do wait "$pid"; done; bun run typecheck:root && bun run typecheck:codegen && bun run typecheck:lint-plugins && bun run typecheck:architecture
scripts.typecheck:architecture: bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types bun scripts/architecture/*.ts && bun node_modules/typescript-codegen/bin/tsc -p scripts/architecture/fixtures/stage0/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun node_modules/typescript-codegen/bin/tsc -p scripts/architecture/fixtures/real-libraries/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:codegen: bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --types bun scripts/generate-provider-option-shapes.ts
scripts.typecheck:lint-plugins: bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types bun scripts/oxlint-plugins/*.mts
scripts.ci: bun run codegen:model-options:check && bun run lint && bun run test:ci && bun run typecheck && bun run fmt:check && echo 'check passed'
